justification: Standard: adds a measurement and tests for a live customer-facing verdict; changes no behaviour. Not Critical: read-only, no served output changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: property_reports product=flood: 308 latest rows per address (0.01s). copernicus_flood_events: EMSR567 one row of 86,349 km2 (5 polygons) vs NSW-202207 410 km2 and NSW-202210 842 km2.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: EMSR567 was assumed to be a flood extent; the ingest merged every shapefile in each ZIP, including area-of-interest layers. run_date is DATE, so latest-per-address needs an id tiebreak.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: scripts/run_flood_calibration_2022.py measures recall on freshly sampled points; this re-scores saved customer inputs. Reuses its worktree .env resolution.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Read-only; a DB connection failure raises and prints nothing, never a partial count.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The rule is fixed but the strict xfail markers are left, or the EMS-alone rule is reintroduced after the fix
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With strict xfail, the 7 EMS-alone cases currently fail as expected (7 xfailed); making them pass without removing the marker turns the run red (XPASS strict).

functions.name: positive_sources
functions.input: saved flood outputs dict for one address
functions.output: list of named sources that indicate flooding
functions.if_none: missing keys count as not positive

functions.name: build_fixture
functions.input: database rows chosen by fixed queries per group
functions.output: fixture JSON with inputs and expected class per case
functions.if_none: a group with fewer rows is printed as k/n and the coverage test fails

queries.purpose: latest saved flood inputs per address
queries.where_clause: product='flood' AND outputs ? 'epi_flood_class' AND address NOT ILIKE 'calibration %'
queries.if_zero: TOTAL=0 is printed; the fixture coverage test fails
queries.if_wrong: same-day ties broken by id so the chosen row is stable

break_it.scenario: The fixture loses a group when rebuilt
break_it.what_happens: Tests pass on a smaller, easier set
break_it.how: test_fixture_covers_every_group requires all 7 groups and at least 21 cases
break_it.repro: delete one group from the fixture and run pytest

break_it.scenario: Someone fixes the rule but forgets the xfail markers
break_it.what_happens: Fixed cases are silently treated as expected failures
break_it.how: xfail strict=True turns an unexpected pass into a failure
break_it.repro: make the 7 cases pass and run pytest

break_it.scenario: Synthetic calibration rows skew the regression counts
break_it.what_happens: Counts would include points that are not customers
break_it.how: LATEST_SQL excludes addresses starting with calibration

break_it.scenario: The latest saved flood inputs per address query picks a different row on each run
break_it.what_happens: Baseline and after-fix runs compare different inputs and report false changes
break_it.how: ORDER BY address, run_date DESC, id DESC makes the latest-per-address choice stable
break_it.repro: run the script twice and compare snapshots
